# Bundled Maple font

User-provided directory: MapleMonoNL-NF-CN-unhinted.
The actual Regular font identifies itself as **Maple Mono NL NFMono CN**,
style **Regular**, version **7.900**.

Only `MapleMonoNL-NFMono-CN-Regular.ttf` is embedded in Toolbox. The supplied
Bold / Italic / BoldItalic files are not used by the character art tool.

SHA256: `f01646c491179bc0cc547d9d5e6e6dc3e3894bd0c13ac2bffaf6ae4acb04b0a1`.
The font bytes are unmodified; CMake pins this hash.

Embedded copyright: Copyright 2022 The Maple Mono Project Authors
(https://github.com/subframe7536/maple-font).

`OFL.txt` was retrieved from the upstream v7.9 tag:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/subframe7536/maple-font/v7.9/OFL.txt
on 2026-10-07. It licenses the font under SIL Open Font License 1.1.
The font was supplied locally; no replacement font was downloaded.
